1
Kunba Nabi Ka Qaid Tha Bazar-e-Sham Tha Hasan Sadiq.
Zainab Thi Sar Barehna Tu Qaidi Imam Tha.
Beti Ali Ki Sar Khulay Darbar-e-Aam Mein.
Abbas Ke Liye Yeh Haya Ka Maqam Tha.

2
Zanjeer-o-Tauq Beriyaan Pehne Hoye Chala.
Sajjad Ke Naseeb Mein Kya Sakht Kam Tha.
Aaya Dar-e-Hussain Pe Qismat Badal Gayi.
Hur Thori Dair Baad Alh Aslam Tha.

3
Tatheer Syeda Ki Rida Ka Jo Naam Hai.
Zainab Teri Rida Ka Tu Abbas Naam Tha.
Abbas Jaisa Bhai Nahi Do Jahan Mein.
Jo Bhai Tha Hussain Ka Lekin Ghulam Tha.

4
Yeh Aaj Jo Sabeelein Lagin Hain Jagah Jagah.
Yeh Bargah Oss Ki Hai Jo Tashna Kam Tha.
Noha Nahi Tha Woh Tu Aqeedat Ke Phool They.
:REHAN AZMI: Ke Qalam Ka Salam Tha.

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/kunba-nabi-ka-qaid-tha-bazar-e-sham-tha-hasan-sadiq-tajpoints-5833c040b7494567574b.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + p], text=True).split('\\n---\\n')[1].strip()
front, body = Path(p).read_text().split('\\n---\\n')
roman = '\\n'.join(s.strip() for s in front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines()).strip()
assert old.lower().replace('.','') == roman.lower()
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '1234'), (body.strip(), '۱۲۳۴')]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in edition.split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [b[0] for b in blocks] == list(numbers)
    assert [len(b) for b in blocks] == [5]*4
print('Verified Roman wording and four matched four-verse stanzas.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 16 verses in Urdu script and kept the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions have four stanzas of four verses. Updated the titles and right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous “Alh Aslam” as `علیہ السلام` and kept the original Roman wording.
